stories.title: Wyndham Championship Opens Thursday — Cameron Young Defending, FedExCup Bubble Begins

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
The final PGA Tour regular-season event starts Thursday.

Wyndham Championship — Sedgefield CC, Greensboro, NC.

Cameron Young defends. $8.5M purse.

The bubble: players between P65 and P75 in FedExCup points fight for their playoff life this week. 🏌️

#PGATour #Wyndham

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
After his Open Championship runner-up finish last month, Cameron Young is back this week as the defending Wyndham champion.

Missed the Claret Jug by 1.

Can he start the playoff push with a title defense?

Sedgefield CC. Thursday-Sunday. 🏆

#PGATour #CameronYoung

stories.title: LIV Golf New York at Bedminster — Rahm vs. DeChambeau in a $20M Showdown

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Same week. Different tour.

LIV Golf New York opens Thursday at Bedminster.

$20M individual purse. $4M to the winner.

Jon Rahm (9/2 fav) leads Bryson DeChambeau by 219 pts in season standings.

This could all but clinch the LIV title for Rahm. 🏌️

#LIVGolf #JonRahm

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf Bedminster this week:

• $20M individual purse
• Course stretched to 7,651 yards
• Rahm 9/2 favorite
• DeChambeau 6/1
• Hatton 13/2

While PGA Tour plays the Wyndham 40 miles up the road.

Two visions of golf's future. One week. ⛳

#LIVGolf #Golf

stories.title: Shiho Kuwaki Wins AIG Women's Open — Japan's First Women's Major Champion of 2026

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Japan's Shiho Kuwaki wins the AIG Women's Open at Royal Lytham.

She defeated Esther Henseleit in a 2-hole playoff.

$1.5M from a record $10M purse.

First LPGA title. First major. Korda and Thitikul finished tied for fourth.

Golf's newest major champion. 🏆

#LPGA #AIGWomensOpen

stories.title: Scottie Scheffler's Winless Drought — World No. 1, Zero Wins Since January

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Scottie Scheffler: No. 1 in the world.
No. 1 in FedExCup points.
Zero wins since January.

20th career title came at the American Express (-27, Jan 2026).

Five runner-up finishes since.

The playoffs start in a week. The drought ends when? ⛳

#PGATour #ScottieScheffler

stories.title: FedExCup Playoffs Begin in One Week — $25M on the Line

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
The FedExCup Playoffs begin in ONE week.

Aug 13-16: St. Jude Championship (top 70)
Aug 20-23: BMW Championship (top 50)
Aug 27-30: TOUR Championship (top 30)

$25M to the winner.

Scheffler leads the standings. Playoffs start Aug 13. 🏆
